title: one-owner-for-the-instance-address
intention: The instance-space address (~/.cairn/devices/<device>/<instance>/) has exactly one owner — Law 6 applied to the settled path.
why: Law 1, literally: the instance-space address is SETTLED — CLAUDE.md carries the instance-0 rule and the 2026-08-12 ruling generalised it to every device, with tools/ and machines/ beneath — and it is re-derived at ten sites in class-space. The lived symptom is not abstract tidiness: provisioning instance 1 of anything today means finding and editing nine files, and a shipped app whose root is not under Akien's home directory cannot run at all, because nine of ten sites bake in Path.home(). Akien's stated reason (II) for the four-rung ruling — 'it leaves open the possibility to expand in the future without rearchitecting that part' — is bought in the DIRECTORY LAYOUT and is not bought in the CODE. This ticket buys the code half.
traces_to: Law 1 ('the resolver is spent on the novel, not on re-deriving the settled; re-deriving a settled answer is a defect') as the primary trace, and the 2026-08-12 ruling's own reason (II) as the proximate one. Partially Law 4 — but only partially, and the ticket is cast saying so: the resolver is a convenience until something REFUSES the alternative, which is child (b).

falsifier.proves_red: DONE, two runnable measures, both at PROVEME by the proof and not by narration: (a) resolving instance 1 of any device requires editing zero path-building sites — checked by pointing the injected roots at a temp dir and resolving device+instance without touching a caller; (b) a grep for Path.home() with '.cairn' and for expanduser('~/.cairn') across non-proof code returns only the resolver module itself, plus the dispositioned inference_domain site. WRONG: the resolver becomes an ELEVENTH place a path is built rather than the only one — the sites keep their hand-spelled copies and the two shapes drift. That failure is already observed in miniature (see measured_at_cast.the_drift_is_not_hypothetical), which is what makes it a live falsifier rather than a decorative one.

children: (b) nothing-spells-an-instance-path-by-hand — the ENFORCEMENT this ticket does not deliver: an import_sieve-shaped rule or a proof tooth that REFUSES Path.home()/'.cairn' and expanduser('~/.cairn') outside the resolver. Not yet cast.

(c) the-inference-overlay-is-off-the-ladder — a DISPOSITION, not a conversion: cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/route.py:44 keeps ~/.cairn/inference/hosts.json outside devices/ entirely. Either instance data at the wrong address, or a ruling that some instance-space is not device-space. A spec question; must not be answered with an edit. Not yet cast.
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(hand-spelled-instance-paths) -> [PROVED]

watchme.trigger: Each heartbeat pulse of base's shim — an event that already fires. The probe reads class-space source, so it needs no runtime event of its own; what it must not do is invent a clock.
watchme.enough: The count of hand-spelled instance-space paths outside the resolver has stood at its floor across three consecutive pulses that each actually EXERCISED the scan, AND the floor is accounted for name by name — today that floor is 1 (the dispositioned inference_domain site). A zero-on-an-unscanned-tree is the vacuous green this field refuses, so the probe carries the scanned file count with the finding and an empty scan is a RED, not a green. Written against the lesson from device-ness-is-decided-at-the-shim, whose first 'enough' described a state that produces no fire: this one is asked after each pulse, not only after a difference.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier measure (b), carrying the count, the named sites, and the number of files scanned.
watchme.nexus: cairn/tools/base's own history and state; the finding also deposits to the build_inspector failures corpus that already reads base's probes.
watchme.consumer: Akien, at his gate. An eleventh hand-spelled path is a spec-level fact about whether reason (II) is holding, not a defect the probe may dispose. The probe carries no authority (Law 6).

in: One root table, in cairn/tools/base, injectable — the single owner of {repo, commons, instance}.
instance_path(device, instance), tool_path(device, instance, tool), machine_path(device, instance, machine) — the three rungs the 2026-08-12 ruling named, resolving device+instance as arguments.
cairn/machines/skill_block/counters.py imports the lowered table instead of defining its own.
Converting the SPELLING at the nine on-ladder sites.
out: PROVISIONING. The resolver RESOLVES AND NEVER TOUCHES DISK — no mkdir, no write, no create-on-read. This is the bound that keeps Law 6 a distinction rather than a collision: computing an address opens nothing, and a resolver that provisioned would be reaching into every device's owned space.
The enforcement that refuses a hand-spelled path — child (b).
cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/route.py:44 — child (c), a spec question, not a conversion.
Whether build_inspector may read chart's instance space at all (Law 6) — this ticket converts that site's SPELLING and takes no position on the ownership question.
WHICH NAMES ARE DEVICES. A resolver computes an address for whatever name it is handed; it is not the roster and must not become one.

chart.why: THE `chart` DISSOLUTION, named by a hand because no rename record can name it (ticket a-bulk-move-forwards-itself-from-gits-own-rename-record, gate 3). The chart machine came apart on 2026-08-13: its 40 files went to skills/chart, seven builder machines under cairn/devices/builder/machines, cairn/tools/chain, cairn/tools/tree and skills/moreabout — no plurality, which is why the derivation correctly answers nothing and a hand must. skills/chart is the successor because the component's CHARTER moved there whole and now covers the skill AND the chain it calls: 'There is no separate device charter: the chart machine dissolved on 2026-08-13 and its charter moved here whole.' A reader following this ref wanted the design record, and that is where it is.
